subject: Data Engineering
title: The Rise of Real-Time
description: A quick win: understand The Rise of Real-Time.

hook.text: Netflix personalizes your homepage in real time. Uber prices update every few seconds.

buildup.text: Users now expect instant feedback. Waiting hours for data to refresh feels broken.

discovery.text: Streaming grew because businesses discovered that faster data means faster decisions and happier users.

twist.text: Real-time doesn't always mean milliseconds. For many use cases, 'within a minute' is fast enough.

climax.text: The real-time revolution isn't about speed for its own sake — it's about matching data to the decision window.

punchline.text: Fast enough depends on the business question.

quiz.question: What drives the adoption of real-time data processing?
options: Faster data enables faster decisions and better user experiences
Real-time is always cheaper than batch
